```{r}
#| include: FALSE
#| message: FALSE
us_states <- map_data("state")
head(us_states)

us_states <- us_states |>
  mutate(state = region) |>
  select(7, 1, 2, 3, 4)

state_data <- as_tibble(usdata::state_stats) |>
  select(state, murder) |> 
  mutate(state = str_to_lower(state))

merged_num <- us_states |>
  left_join(state_data, by = "state")

states_sf <- 
  read_sf("https://rstudio.github.io/leaflet/json/us-states.geojson") |>
  select(name, geometry) |>
  filter(name != "Puerto Rico") |>
  mutate(state = name) |>
  mutate(state = str_to_lower(state)) |>
  select(3, 2)
```

```{r}
#| message: FALSE
#| echo: FALSE

full_num_sf <- merged_num |>
  left_join(states_sf) |>
  filter(state != "district of columbia")

full_num_sf |>
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group)) + 
    geom_polygon(aes(fill = murder), color = "black") + 
    labs(fill = "Murders per 100,000 people", 
         caption = "Data sourced from Census Quick Facts.", 
         x = "Longitude",
         y = "Latitude",
         title = "Murder Rates across the United States",
         subtitle = "As estimated in 2020") +
    coord_map() +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "PuRd", 
                       direction = 1,
                       breaks= c(1.5, 3.5, 5.5, 7.5, 9.5)
  ) + 
  theme_calc()
```

```{r}
#| message: FALSE
#| include: FALSE
states_num <- states |>
  mutate(name = str_to_lower(name),
         state = name) |>
  left_join(merged_num) |>
  select(id, state, murder, geometry, long, lat) |>
  filter(state != "puerto rico", state != "district of columbia")
```


```{r}
#| warning: FALSE
#| message: FALSE
#| echo: FALSE

bins_num <- c(1, 3.5, 5.5, 7.5, 9.5, Inf)
pal_num <- colorBin("PuRd", domain = states_num$murder, bins = bins_num)

# Create labels that pop up when we hover over a state.  The labels must
#   be part of a list where each entry is tagged as HTML code.


states_num <- states_num |>
  mutate(labels = str_c(state, ": ", murder, " murders / 100k people"))

labels <- lapply(states_num$labels, HTML)

leaflet(states_num) |>
  setView(-96, 37.8, 4) |>
  addTiles() |>
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal_num(murder),
    weight = 2,
    opacity = 1,
    color = "white",
    dashArray = "3",
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 5,
      color = "#666",
      dashArray = "",
      fillOpacity = 0.7,
      bringToFront = TRUE),
    label = labels,
    labelOptions = labelOptions(
      style = list("font-weight" = "normal", padding = "3px 8px"),
      textsize = "15px",
      direction = "auto")) |>
  addLegend(pal = pal_num, values = ~murder, opacity = 0.7, title = NULL,
    position = "bottomright")
```
